add_densepose_config: add all DensePose configuration options to a Detectron2 CfgNode in one call
add_densepose_head_config: add DensePose head configuration options including predictor, loss, and decoder settings to a CfgNode
add_densepose_head_cse_config: add Continuous Surface Embeddings CSE configuration options for embedding size, loss, and cycle consistency to a CfgNode
add_hrnet_config: add HRNet backbone configuration options for stages 2 through 4 and HRFPN to a CfgNode
add_evaluation_config: add DensePose evaluation configuration options including IOU threshold, storage type, and distributed inference to a CfgNode
